exposure: Availability of emergency obstetric care services
Accessibility of emergency obstetric care services
Quality of emergency obstetric care services
Availability of essential resources for maternal and child health services
outcome: Proportion of functioning basic EmONC facilities
Gap in minimum provision of EmONC facilities per 500,000 population
Met need for major direct obstetric complications
cohort: The study included 79 health facilities in Zanzibar.
finding: Only 7.6% of health facilities qualified as functioning basic EmONC facilities and 9% as comprehensive EmONC facilities, with a national met need for obstetric complications being only 33.1%.
